page.title: Explore systems. Understand responsibility. Follow evidence.
page.subtitle: CALYR turns fragmented organisational and scientific information into navigable evidence networks.
page.insight_copy: Oracles combine Pythia predictions, domain constraints, uncertainty, and adaptive AI-based user experiences in one usable system.
page.hpc_copy: High-Performance Computing on systems including VSC-5 generates the data that Pythia compresses into fast, explainable prediction.

copy.mission: Pythia turns data into surrogate prediction. Oracles turn prediction into decisions and engineered results.
copy.empty_story_item: The Pythia chain connects data, surrogate models, prediction, and oracles.

workflow.title: From contact to validated model.
workflow.introduction: Build the smallest system that can test the largest assumption.

phases.title: Contact & context analysis
phases.copy: Requirements, data, target variables and constraints become an explicit problem frame.

phases.title: Predesign
phases.copy: Decompose the problem; define architecture, validation metrics and stop criteria.

phases.title: Rapid MVP prototyping
phases.copy: Implement the smallest end-to-end workflow and test it on deliberately small datasets.

phases.title: Pretraining on the CALYR.AI Cube
phases.copy: Iterate locally on the surrogate, data pipeline and training logic before scale-up.

phases.title: Specification review
phases.copy: Review model, data, compute and expected value against the project specification.

phases.title: VSC-5 training
phases.copy: Scale and train the model only when the core assumption holds.

phases.title: Validation & falsification
phases.copy: Test results against reference data, simulation and previously defined success criteria.

phases.title: Deployable MVP
phases.copy: Deliver a demonstrator, API, interface or decision model with an explicit validity envelope.

decisions.negative: Assumption fails — redesign, simplify or stop
Not validated — return to predesign, data or pretraining

questions: Does the problem definition match the available evidence?
Does the MVP already create measurable value?
Does model quality justify the next scale step?
Does VSC-5 training improve the relevant target metrics?
Can the central assumption be validated or falsified?
workflow.closing: Rapid prototyping. Early falsification. Scalable validation.
